messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning routing policy update for APAC -> EU spillover at 23:30 UTC tonight. small stair-step DNS weight shift over 15m. Will run smoke checks. Ping if conflicts.
maria: I'll own the smoke checklist and watch logs. What TTL are we using?
alex: TTL 60s. Stair-step: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% every ~4m. rollback immediately if 5xx spike >2% in any region for 3m.
sunil: I'll be the deployer. I'll kick it off at 23:30 + watch latency aggregates. @maria you'll have access to synthetic probes?
maria: yes, probes in grafana.redwood/apps/edge-probes (share). I'll run /check-smoke command.
jen: Can someone confirm whether private deployments in APAC need routing exemption? We have one enterprise customer pinned in sg-region.
alex: Good catch — exempting pinned customers. sunil add policy tag `exclude:enterprise-sg` in rollout config.
sunil: added in config:
```yaml
rollout:
  steps: [10,30,60,100]
  ttl_sec: 60
  exclude_tags: ["enterprise-sg"]
```
deploy-bot: sunil started preflight at 23:20 UTC — all checks pass: certs, dns propagation, capacity. :white_check_mark: 
maria: Smoke checklist (short): 1) synthetic latency probes 2) 99th p50/p95 on serving 3) error rate by p99 4) kv-cache hit ratio quick check. I'll paste results during rollout.
alex: rollback plan: run `reroute rollback --policy apac-eu-stair` which will revert weights to previous and set ttl back to 300 for 10m to stabilize.
sunil: I'll tag the run with `run=asia-eu-190112` so we can filter logs.
nate: I'll be on-call for DB-side effects; reachable on phone if anything weird.
maria: pre-roll smoke: probes green, p95 stable, no 5xx spike. Ready from my side.
jen: LGTM from product ops — customer exclusion confirmed.
sunil: kicking off step1 (10%) now.
deploy-bot: routing update applied: apac weight 10% -> eu 90% (step 1) at 23:30:30 UTC.
maria: checks after step1: latency +2ms avg, p95 +15ms, errors 0.4% (within threshold). continue.
sunil: proceeding to 30% in 4m.
deploy-bot: routing update applied: step2 30% at 23:34:45 UTC.
maria: step2 checks: slight latency bump in sg-edge, p95 +40ms; keeping an eye. No error spike.
alex: if p95 > 100ms or 5xx >2% hold and contact infra-sre.
sunil: stepping to 60% now.
deploy-bot: applied 60% at 23:39:10 UTC.
maria: step3: errors 0.8% in a cluster — still below 2%. kv-cache hit down 3% but expected.
nate: DB metrics stable.
sunil: final to 100%.
deploy-bot: applied 100% at 23:43:55 UTC. all routing weights at target.
maria: final smoke: looks clean. publishing summary in runbook.
alex: thanks all. I'll leave the routing policy in place and mark rollout complete. :tada: 
ops-runbook: Run annotated: https://runbook.redwood/rollouts/asia-eu-190112
